sections.heading: History
sections.text:
An ancient clan of Seekers sealed up Araknos's Ring in this temple. [The Mission]

In the late 1950s, the temple was discovered by Eathon Lambert, Metz and Simon Judeau while on a mission for the Huntik Foundation. They found a warning that the Titan was protected with a mortal curse, but Judeau ignored it and tried to take the ring. He was thus afflicted by the curse. [The Secret of Two Generations]
